name: Nicolas Boizard
metaDescription: Member of Technical Staff at Cohere (pretraining) and PhD candidate at CentraleSupélec. Multilingual & multimodal LLMs: BidirLM-Omni, EuroBERT, EuroLLM.
bioPlain: Member of Technical Staff on the pretraining team at Cohere, scaling up model training, and PhD candidate at CentraleSupélec (Université Paris-Saclay), advised by Pierre Colombo and Céline Hudelot, defending in early 2027. PhD research on large-scale training of multilingual and multimodal LLMs, both decoders and encoders (EuroLLM, CroissantLLM, BidirLM-Omni, EuroBERT), and on distillation, such as the Universal Logit Distillation Loss for cross-tokenizer distillation.
bioHtml: I'm a Member of Technical Staff at Cohere on the pretraining team where, to put it simply, my goal is to make the model size go up and the loss curve go down. I'm also finishing my PhD at CentraleSupélec with Pierre Colombo and Céline Hudelot, with my defense planned for early 2027.

My research covers large-scale training of multilingual and multimodal LLMs, both decoders and encoders (EuroLLM, CroissantLLM, BidirLM-Omni, EuroBERT), and distillation, such as the Universal Logit Distillation Loss for cross-tokenizer distillation.

portrait.alt: Nicolas Boizard in front of the Golden Gate Bridge

highlights.note: Open multilingual decoders for European languages, and a truly bilingual French–English model.
Multilingual and omnimodal bidirectional encoders. BidirLM-Omni ranks first among open models on MTEB, MIEB and MAEB at its size.
Cross-tokenizer logit distillation, adopted by Hugging Face and Axolotl, and a compute-equivalent study of reasoning distillation.
